label.description: A moderation label applied by an allowlisted moderation service to a record or an account hosted by this Stratos service.

seq.description: Position of this label in the service's label sequence.

val.description: The label value. The service enforces which values it accepts.

neg.description: If true, this label negates (removes) a prior label with the same subject and value. Absent means false.

ref.description: Optional moderation-service reference for this action, such as a report or case identifier.

recordSubject.description: A record in this service's storage.

uri.description: The record's at:// URI, either at://{did}/{collection}/{rkey} or the space form at://{authority}/space/{type}/{skey}/{author}/{collection}/{rkey}. Declared as a plain string because the at-uri format rejects URIs with more than two path segments.

cid.description: Not accepted yet. A takedown applies to every version of a record, so createLabel refuses a subject with a cid as SubjectCidNotSupported. A label returned by queryLabels can still carry one.

accountSubject.description: An account hosted by this service.
